patterns: Overwhelmingly 'institute - location' single-fact items (CTRI Rajahmundry, NRCWA Bhubaneswar, NATMO Kolkata, NIO Goa, IIFM Bhopal, FRI Dehradun, NIV Pune).
APPSC tilts to AP-located institutes and recent S&T news items (LIGO-India lead labs, ICAR lumpy skin vaccine, IIT research items).
Mismatch-pair format ('not correctly matched') is common in other PSCs; APPSC mostly direct one-liners.
App adds founding years, parent departments, BARC reactor trivia and mega-science partner details beyond PYQ depth, but mostly sound.
